```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "../scripts")
from theme import ESPRIT, evolution_bar, evolution_cumul, mpl_barh, mpl_donut

from itables import init_notebook_mode, show
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=True, connected=True)

enc = pd.read_csv("../data/encadrants.csv")
for c in enc.select_dtypes(include="object").columns:
    enc[c] = enc[c].astype(str).str.strip()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

n_total = len(enc)
n_etudiants = enc[["nom", "prenom"]].drop_duplicates().shape[0]
n_soutenus = enc["statut"].str.contains("Soutenu|Terminé", na=False).sum()
n_encours = (enc["statut"] == "En cours").sum()

print(f'''
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:0.8rem;margin:1rem 0;">
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_total}</span><span class="label">Encadrements</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_etudiants}</span><span class="label">Étudiants</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_soutenus}</span><span class="label">Soutenus / Terminés</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="value">{n_encours}</span><span class="label">En cours</span></div>
</div>
''')
```

## Évolution temporelle

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

evolution_bar(enc, "Encadrements par année et niveau",
              [ESPRIT[2], ESPRIT[0], ESPRIT[4]]).show()
evolution_cumul(enc, "Encadrements cumulés au fil des années",
                "#0277BD", "rgba(2,119,189,0.08)").show()
```

## Répartitions

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

mpl_barh(enc["domaine"].value_counts(), "Encadrements par domaine", couleur="#0277BD")
mpl_donut(enc["niveau"].str.strip().value_counts(), "Répartition par niveau",
          colors=[ESPRIT[3], ESPRIT[4], ESPRIT[1]])
```

## Liste des encadrements

```{python}
#| echo: false
table = enc.sort_values("annee", ascending=False)[["annee", "nom", "prenom", "niveau", "formation", "domaine", "perimetre", "statut"]]
table.columns = ["Année", "Nom", "Prénom", "Niveau", "Formation", "Domaine", "Périmètre", "Statut"]
show(table, lengthMenu=[15, 30, 50, 100], classes="display compact")
```
